patch.value: pm-cli 2026.7.18 introduced a built-in `pm graph` command group (traversals, analytics, governance audit). Our registerExporter("graph") auto-created `pm graph export`, which now grafts an extension subcommand onto the core group: merged confusing help, and the alias path drops option contracts (upstream pm-cli#574), so `pm graph export --format mermaid` fails with 'Too many arguments'. Fix: rename the adapter to graph-export (mirrors pm-csv csv-export), update README positioning vs the core command. Tracked in companion repo (pm-cli-website) 2026-07-18 session.
Exporter adapter 'graph' collides with new core pm graph command group (pm-cli 2026.7.18)
Renamed exporter adapter to graph-export; core pm graph help is clean again; README repositioned vs core command; regression test guards the adapter name.
